result.brief: 提出教师-学生世界-动作模型，用JEPA式自监督学习时序潜动作并预测未来视觉特征，端到端联合优化表征、视觉动力学与机器人控制。
result.reason: Contributes JEPA-style temporal latent-action representation learning plus latent world model predicting future visual features, jointly trained with VLA policy; representation and dynamics are core contributions.
